# Provenance: entry_picks_automatic_subs

**Source**: live `GET /api/entry/4685107/event/5/picks/` from the real FPL API on
2026-10-20 (curl, no auth), for #116 (AC6).

**Edits**: a self-cohort id, gameweek 5, a week with two automatic substitutions (`automatic_subs` non-empty);
untrimmed. Values are otherwise as received (re-indented, key order kept). The response carries no manager or team names, so none were removed.
